verdict.rationale: Brex says its business account can earn yield of up to 3.70% (brex-docs-10), so part of the treasury-yield axis is covered. Nothing in the pack shows a dedicated savings sub-account for a cash cushion or any automated transfer rules; the Payments and Transactions APIs cover only outbound payments and viewing accounts. Missing for 10: a dedicated high-yield savings sub-account, rule-based automated sweeps or transfers into it, and documentation or hands-on corroboration of the cash-cushion workflow.
